meta.name: seo
meta.description: SEO analysis and optimization skill. Analyze search performance, optimize content, track rankings, and improve organic traffic using Search Console, Ahrefs, SE Ranking, and Google Analytics data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析搜索数据优化内容提升自然流量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想提升网站在搜索引擎的排名和自然访问量。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze search data, optimize content, and grow organic traffic.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve your website's search ranking and organic traffic.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会利用已接入的搜索数据工具,分析流量、排名与关键词,找出表现不佳的页面,并给出标题、结构、内链等具体优化建议;还会把审查结果写入文档。
howto.when: 当你询问 SEO 表现、搜索排名或内容优化建议,或要求“检查搜索表现”时触发。

say.text: 看看我们最近 28 天的搜索表现
say.note: Claude 会汇总点击、曝光、点击率和平均排名。

say.text: 找出曝光高但点击率低的页面
say.note: Claude 会定位这些页面并给出标题和摘要优化建议。

say.text: 给这篇文章做 SEO 优化建议
say.note: 提供链接后,Claude 会给出具体改进点。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude will connect to your analytics tools, analyze traffic, rankings and keywords, flag underperforming pages, and give concrete recommendations on titles, structure, internal links, etc. It will also save the review to a file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about SEO performance, search rankings, or content optimization, or when creating/updating content for better search visibility.

say_en.text: Check our search performance for the last 28 days.
say_en.note: Pulls clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position.

say_en.text: Find pages with high impressions but low CTR.
say_en.note: Flags pages and suggests title and meta improvements.

say_en.text: Give SEO recommendations for this article.
say_en.note: Share the URL to get specific on-page fixes.
